name: Quick Pill 5.2.0
changelog: Added native Windows WinRT media controls with direct support for Brave, Chrome, Spotify, Edge, and VLC.
Enabled interactive waveform scrubber seeking to jump directly to any track timestamp.
Integrated multi-source auto-updater with fallback manifest resolution and zero startup latency.
Performance optimizations: 98% web asset size reduction and instant optimistic UI playback feedback.
